generation_prompt: Create a premium cinematic logo emblem for LAVIDA CARWASH AND LOUNGE. Use a deep obsidian-black background, a refined circular gold crest with a pointed ornamental base, an elegant adult feminine silhouette in a deep-crimson evening gown at the upper center, a glossy black luxury sedan surrounded by tasteful water spray and foam on the left, and an upscale green-felt snooker table with cue and balls plus warm lounge-bar lighting on the right. Place LAVIDA prominently in large metallic-gold serif capitals, with CARWASH AND LOUNGE beneath it in widely spaced ivory sans-serif capitals. Along the bottom, include five small gold service symbols and labels: CARWASH, FOOD, DRINKS, SNOOKER, KARAOKE & GAMES. Keep the composition balanced, luxurious, high contrast, crisp, and suitable for premium hospitality branding. Spell all requested text exactly. Do not add other words, watermarks, or car manufacturer logos.

integration_notes.web: Store the selected logo asset in the frontend public assets directory and reference it by a stable path.
integration_notes.android: Export a simplified icon variant for small sizes; tiny service labels should not be relied on at app-icon scale.
integration_notes.carss_data_policy: Treat the logo as a brand asset, not as menu, pricing, inventory or payment data.
